subtitle: Discover our most popular journey through Turkmenistan.

tour.title: 3 days with Nokhur
tour.description: A 3-day adventure from the Nokhur through the ancient ruins, ending in the marble city of Ashgabat.

plan.title: Ashgabat
plan.desc: City tour covering the main highlights: Ancient Nissa (UNESCO), Turkmenbashi Mosque, Earthquake Memorial, Independence Park, Arch of Neutrality, Wedding Palace and the National Museum.

plan.title: Nokhur & Kow-ata
plan.desc: Drive to Nokhur village → ancient Chynar tree → Kiz Bibi shrine in the mountains (ancient decorated graves along the way). After lunch, head back to Ashgabat → swim in the Kow-ata underground lake → Geokdepe Mosque.

plan.title: Ashgabat
plan.desc: Carpet Museum, Alley of Inspiration, Ertogrul Ghazi Mosque, Art Gallery, Berkarar Shopping Mall and Akhal-Teke horse stable.
